bug_semantics: TurnServer.ReceiveUdpAsync wraps only UdpClient.ReceiveAsync in the inner try; HandleUdpDatagram (which calls STUNMessage.ParseSTUNMessage) sits inside the while but outside that try, and the generic catch (Exception) is lexically outside the while. Start() launches ReceiveUdpAsync fire-and-forget with no supervision. A pre-auth UDP datagram whose first byte is 0x80-0xFF is not ChannelData, so ParseSTUNHeader throws ApplicationException; the exception unwinds past the loop, is logged, and the method returns while _running stays true. The TURN UDP relay is then dead for all clients until process restart (whole-server DoS). A short datagram can also NRE in ParseSTUNMessage; the advisory cites the ApplicationException path.
flaw_origin: The catch-outside-loop UDP receive structure, unguarded HandleUdpDatagram/ParseSTUNMessage, and fire-and-forget Start() were first written when the in-process RFC 5766 TurnServer was added. Reconstructable PR #1513 member 6edd60f593a467be6ac654c71f57284665f59df1 created src/net/TURN/TurnServer.cs with that exact mechanism (ReceiveUdpAsync lines 430-452, HandleUdpDatagram calling ParseSTUNMessage at 478, Start _ = ReceiveUdpAsync() at 258). Parent 781c6b8e7b8972428a8d520fa16edfc6da8d50ac has no TurnServer.cs. GitHub squash-merged the PR as dd767827e6005e653ec6e8ddc9a43eb1de84d865 with an identical TurnServer.cs blob; aebe49c later only moved the file to src/SIPSorcery/net/TURN/TurnServer.cs. Later TURN updates (#1636) did not relocate the catch inside the loop.

reasoning: The advisory is a real unauthenticated TURN UDP DoS from exception handling that lets a STUN parse throw kill the fire-and-forget receive loop. That exact control-flow was present in the first TurnServer.cs write, survived the repo-consolidation move and later TURN feature work, and is what #1774 isolates. The smallest first-write is reconstructable PR member 6edd60f, not squash dd767827 or the later path move. That member (and the squash) carry commit-object Co-Authored-By Claude Opus 4.6 on the code that first wrote the flawed mechanism, so AI_ROOT_CAUSE.
